meeting.summary: FY2021–22 budget discussion. Topics included Class C road-fund decrease, festival funding, MDA-review process, Sheriff's Office support and VIPS equipment, paving Wasatch Wing and Clay Road, the truck/equipment storage building, and a proposal to raise the General Fund reserve from 25% to 35% (or 27.5%) to balance bonding against project priorities (sewer plant expansion, Mid Valley Road, Well One, public-safety building land).
